blends.name: Galaxy Fighter
blends.desc:
**Galaxy Fighter**

The Galaxy Fighter is a mythical NFT, embodying the ultimate fusion of strength, strategy, and the boundless spirit of the Fox’s way of life. This emblem is a testament to the dedication and passion of a true 5MinuteMasters collector, who has meticulously blended a rare and powerful collection of NFTs.

Why Blend?
What’s New and How to Use It

We’re excited to announce a special reward system for completing older blends. These blends will remain available until they are either minted out or all packs are opened. By completing these blends, you’ll earn corresponding Discord roles that grant you extra entries into our giveaways with the WaxPortal Bot.

Bonus Entries:
Mythic Fighter: 7 Extra Entries
Epic Fighter: 5 Extra Entries
Rare Fighter: 3 Extra Entries
Complete the blend, earn your role, and boost your chances to win in our exciting giveaways!

5-Radio Active K-9 (Nikolai): A formidable ally, radiating power and resilience.
5-Blue Booty (Meta): A digital treasure, rare and highly coveted, a gem of the meta seas.
4-Baby Fox Hunter: The young predator, born with the instincts of a hunter.
4-Star Fighter MasterFox: The ultimate warrior, a beacon of combat excellence and rarity.
2-Psycho Fighter: A fierce and unpredictable combatant, embodying raw power.
1-Chest of FoxHood: A symbol of unparalleled dedication and mastery within the NFT realm.
1-Space Fighter Fox: A celestial warrior, navigating the vast expanse of the galaxy with unmatched skill.

This mythical blend represents the pinnacle of NFT collecting, a symbol of the collector’s journey through the digital cosmos. The Galaxy Fighter is not just a token; it is a mark of strategic brilliance and relentless pursuit of greatness. Though it may not be used in the upcoming 1 of 1, its presence hints at the endless possibilities and the next legendary creation just around the corner.

Display the Galaxy Fighter with pride, for it signifies a true legend in the world of NFTs, a collector who has embraced the Fox’s way of life and mastered the art of blending the extraordinary.

🌌✨ The Mythic Blend: Unleash Legendary Power! ✨🌌
Why Blend?
What’s New and How to Use It

We’re excited to announce a special reward system for completing older blends. These blends will remain available until they are either minted out or all packs are opened. By completing these blends, you’ll earn corresponding Discord roles that grant you extra entries into our giveaways with the WaxPortal Bot.

Bonus Entries:

Mythic Fighter: 7 Extra Entries
Epic Fighter: 5 Extra Entries
Rare Fighter: 3 Extra Entries
Complete the blend, earn your role, and boost your chances to win in our exciting giveaways!

Welcome, brave adventurer, to the realm of the Mythic Blend – where the ordinary transforms into the extraordinary, and legends are born! This sacred alchemy requires the perfect combination of NFTs to unlock unparalleled power and prestige. Here’s the mystical recipe:

Mythic Blend Recipe:
(4) Meta Level 1s: The foundation stones, common yet essential, imbued with hidden potential.
(3) Meta Level 2s: Uncommon gems, adding a layer of strength and resilience.
(2) Meta Level 3s: Rare artifacts, each one a beacon of formidable power.
(1) Meta Level 4: The crown jewel, ultra-rare and legendary, the heart of the blend.
Plus 5 Commons (Radio Active K-9) from the 5 Minute Masters Battle Pack: The final touch, completing the blend with their unique essence.
